content: iOS web push: requires Home Screen install and user-gesture permission prompt; action buttons unsupported (no Answer/Decline buttons); notificationclick clients.openWindow deep-linking unreliable (often opens previous page or root when backgrounded). Each push MUST show a visible notification or Safari revokes subscription after ~3 silent pushes. Safari 18.4 added Declarative Web Push. Mitigation: app reconciles state on open/visibilitychange (check server for ringing call/unread) rather than relying on deep link URL.
